title: Beginning Sounds Worksheets — Letter Sounds and Letter Recognition Activities (FREE)

overview.description: Beginning sounds worksheets targeting initial letter sounds and letter recognition. From the filename: activities that connect letter shapes to their sounds through pictures of objects that start with each letter. Likely format: letter at top + images below, child identifies/circles/colors items that start with that letter's sound. Link expired before download.

notes: Link expired. This fills the gap between letter identification (I Spy) and phoneme substitution in Aless's ELA progression: letter ID → beginning sounds → rhyming → compound words → phoneme substitution. The beginning sounds skill (which letter does 'ball' start with?) is foundational for decoding.
